description: rfc/SERVICE-IDENTITIES.md §8: service anchors. Identities = deriveServiceIdentity(master, serviceId, {role: organization}), master = SHA-256("vaultysid/test/" || masterName), a PUBLIC test value. valid: verifyServiceAnchor(anchor, serviceId) returns the identity with this DID. invalid: it returns null.

hybrid.description: Anchors of hybrid service identities: deriveServiceIdentity(master, serviceId, {alg: "dilithium_ed25519", role: "organization", postQuantum}), same master. ML-DSA-87 half signed with the deterministic variant of FIPS 204 (rnd = 0). valid: verifyServiceAnchor returns the identity with this DID, and the derived identity has this DID and SHA-256 of its serialized id. invalid: verifyServiceAnchor returns null.

invalid.name: signature reduced to its Ed25519 half
